notes.title: GAME OFFICIAL RELEASE
notes.content: On JUNE 14th, 2022, the game is officially released!  There is a 10% discount for the first week only, get a copy now!

notes.title: 🍼👶 Talk with the Developer | 4 player co-op Re-broadcast
notes.content:
Learn more about the game while you watch 4 of my friends pamper and spoil the little ones.

The Developer is there live to answer any questions from chat, and the gameplay footage is a recording.

During the stream I will be asking trivia questions and will reward keys to the first person to answer it correctly!

notes.title: Mollycoddle Mayhem Developer Live Stream
notes.content: Watch the developer play the game.  Learn about how it all started.  Will try to answer all questions.  Don't be shy!

notes.title: Demo Released!
notes.content:
Demo contains:
-6 levels (3 from the tutorial, and 3 from the food court / mall)
-2 Unlocked items (coffee and the ghost blanket)
-Unlockable skins for the baby

Just a reminder you can get bonus coins for replaying the same level.  Use bonus coins to:
-Unlock baby cosmetics
-Unlock the next level (if your score is too low)

Also General Bug fixes

notes.title: Bug Fixes June 1st, 2022
notes.content:
Controller Reconnection Bugfix
-Controller can disconnect and reconnect during character selection screen

Chinese subtitles Bugfix
-Kung-fu girl has subtitles fixed for Simplified Chinese translations

notes.title: June Update 2022
notes.content:
Added subtitles / conversation texts for 3 additional languages!
[list]
[*]French
[*]Spanish
[*]Simplified Chinese
[/list]

Added a leaderboard (tied to Steam) to track the top scores for each individual level!  The scores doesn't factor in the amount of players per level, so grab your friends to maximize your group's potential!

Created a new website and added a press kit for streamers / youtubers who is interested in trying out my game.

Website: www.mollycoddlemayhem.com

Let me know if you want a language added to the game!  Email me at: mollycoddlemayhem@gmail.com
